description: Rust-owned golden contract for the intern payroll engine (src-tauri/src/services/intern_payroll.rs + cutoff_payroll.rs). Expected values were produced by running the real engine (see docs/payroll-operations.md); money is in centavos for intern cases and cutoff results. Policy: PHP 80/day base, PHP 10/hour late (ceil) and undertime, lunch 12:00-13:00 unpaid, 18:00+ time-outs capped to 17:00, arrival at/after 12:00 is a half-day, daily pay floored at 0; weekly grace (08:01-08:15, once per Manila Monday week) applies to attendance dates before 2026-10-01 only.
